name: SiteHeader
description: Render a site header with a logo, responsive menu, and optional additional components.

backgroundColor.description: The single background colour of the component.

breakpoint.description: Viewport breakpoint (in pixels or rem) at which to switch from the "mobile" style menu to "desktop" style menu; use 0 to always use the "mobile" style or null to always use the "desktop" style

context.description: The kebab-case or BEM element chain name of the parent component or variant (if contextually relevant).

logoUrl.description: The URL of the site logo image

overlayBackgroundColor.description: Background colour of the overlay when responsiveStyle is set to 'overlay'

responsiveStyle.description: The layout style of the responsive menu when below the breakpoint

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set.

size.description: Keyword specifying the relative width of the container for the inner content if the component is not nested inside another layout component. Should be ignored if the component has an isNested attribute set to true, or other logic determines that it is nested.

submenuIcon.description: Icon class name for the submenu toggle button in responsive mode

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests

innerComponents.description: The inner components other than the logo; to define which are part of the responsive menu, wrap them in a Group with the context "responsive" (note: only one responsive group is supported)
